account.notes: The public REST parser and MCP server are keyless. Context-aware interpretation and higher-volume partner access require review.

mechanisms.description: Use the public DreamGraph REST parser immediately without an account or API key. Dream text is processed ephemerally and is not stored or turned into a contribution.
Connect AI agents to the public DreamThreads MCP server for bounded dream parsing and DreamGraph concept search. No account or API key is required.
Request a reviewed partner key for context-aware interpretation, higher-volume access, embeds, and production integrations.

scopes.notes: Public parsing and concept search are keyless. Partner keys authorize the reviewed endpoints enabled for that integration.

steps.description: Parse a dream into structured features without storing its narrative.

economics.model: free public access with reviewed partner access
economics.freeTier: Public REST parsing: 12 requests per minute and 100 per day per client. Public MCP: 60 protocol requests per minute per client.
economics.pricing: The public parser and MCP tools are free. Partner pricing is scoped during review and is not yet standardized publicly.

gaps: Partner pricing is scoped during review rather than published as a standardized rate card.
